plumbing.name: 2018 NC Residential Code plumbing chapters (25-33); NC Plumbing Code excludes 1- and 2-family dwellings

elsewhere: The NC State Building Code applies statewide and is mandatory; local governments may not amend it. Energy edition is flagged as 2018 NCECC by Cary; energycodes.gov says 2015 IECC (eff 2019-01-01) for the residential code.
notes: Conflict on energy edition: 2018 NCECC (Cary) vs 2015 IECC base (DOE). 2024 NC codes delayed past 2027-03-01. Second check: 2024 NC codes (2021 I-code base) delayed; Cary says not effective until after 2027-03-01.
